title: Quantization/Decoding Variability x Monitor Calibration: The Backstop Drifts With Deployment Settings

original_idea.body: Hold a monitor fixed and vary policy decoding temperature and quantization on a control task, measuring detection-rate drift attributable purely to deployment-config change.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Monitor decalibration across deployment configs affects safety-case transfer, but the chain has a gap (engineering-drift, not adversarial).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Vary temperature/quantization, measure detection drift; accessible, single GPU.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open-weight quantization is an external-ecosystem concern, lab-independent.

novelty.reasoning: Decoding-consistency studied; the monitor-calibration-drift angle may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Decoding consistency studied; the monitor-drift framing may be open.
